name: Hob's Harvest
summary: Farmer Hob needs help bringing in a crop. He'll lend seeds and a watering can.
offer: Them rats ate my seed potatoes, and my back's too sore to dig.
Here's some seed and my old watering can. Plant 'em in the allotments west of the coop.
Water each stage for a bigger crop, and use compost if you've got it: keeps the blight off.
after: My wife's cabbage soup recipe is yours now. Don't tell her I gave it away!
I sell seeds and supplies if you want to keep farming.

stages.journal: Grow and bring Farmer Hob 5 potatoes and 3 onions from the allotments.
remind: Five taters and three onions, that's all I ask. The allotments are just west of the hen coop.
Right-click an allotment to plant, water and harvest.
done: Ha! Fat, healthy spuds. You've the knack for it.

name: A Fishy Favour
summary: Marta's fish supplier has vanished and the Gilded Tankard's regulars are hungry.
offer: My fishmonger's run off with a bard, and the dinner crowd's getting restless.
Could you catch and cook some fish for me? Old Maren down at Lake Mirren sells nets and rods.
after: Take my grandmother's fisherman's pie recipe. It needs swordfish, so you'll want that harpoon.

remind: Five roast perch to start. Net them in the shallows, cook them on a fire.
done: Lovely! That'll keep them quiet for an hour.

stages.journal: Bring Marta 5 grilled trout and 2 salmon fillets.
remind: Now something grander: five grilled trout and two salmon fillets. You'll need a rod and bait.
done: Oh, these are perfect. The regulars will weep.

name: The Smith's Apprentice
summary: Brom will teach you the forge if you prove you can smelt and hammer.
offer: Want to learn the forge? Hah! Everyone does till they burn their eyebrows off.
Take this hammer and pickaxe. Mine copper and tin at the Aldmoor Quarry north-east of town, smelt them here.
after: My greatsword notes are yours. They'll work for any metal you can smith.

stages.journal: Smelt and bring Brom 5 bronze bars.
remind: Five bronze bars. One copper and one tin make a bar, at my furnace.
done: Decent bars. Not too many bubbles.

stages.journal: Forge a bronze longsword at an anvil and show it to Brom.
remind: Now forge me a bronze longsword at the anvil. Hammer in your pack, mind.
done: Balanced, sharp... you've the makings of a smith.

name: Threads of Fortune
summary: Ilse the Weaver has a noble's order to fill and no one to help her.
offer: A baroness wants a whole wardrobe by the new moon and my fingers are raw!
Gather cocoons from my mulberry grove, spin them at my wheel and weave them at my loom.
after: My dyer's handbook and my spidersilk patterns are yours. Madder dyes crimson, woad dyes azure.

stages.journal: Bring Ilse 3 bolts of silk cloth.
remind: Three bolts of silk cloth. Three threads to a bolt, three cocoons to... no, one cocoon to a thread.
done: Smooth and even. Now for something daring.

stages.journal: Bring Ilse 5 spider silk from the giant spiders below Aldmoor.
remind: Five strands of giant spider silk. The spiders lurk in the Goblin Caves and the Crypt. Their webs can be harvested too, if you're skilled.
done: You brave soul! The baroness will be dressed like a queen.

name: Sigils of the Circle
summary: Archmage Elara suspects the hexers at the stone circle are stealing the ley-power.
offer: The ley lines are weakening. The Ashen Circle's hexers are draining the stones.
First, prove you understand sigilcraft. Then deal with them.
after: The Tome of Storms is yours. Carve storm sigils at my table, or at the dark altar for twice the yield... if you dare.

stages.journal: Carve and bring Elara 40 gale sigils and a sapphire.
remind: Forty gale sigils, carved from essence at my enchanting table, and a sapphire from the quarry.
done: Clean work. Now for the hexers.

stages.journal: Defeat 6 hexers at the stone circle.
remind: Six hexers at the stone circle, east beyond the river. Mind their curses.
done: The stones feel lighter already. Thank you.

name: Timber for the Town
summary: Gerd the Woodsman needs timber to repair Aldmoor's palisade.
offer: The palisade's rotting and the goblins know it. I need good timber, fast.
Ash and elm grow all around Darkwood's edge. Bring me the logs.
after: Take my elder longbow design. Elder trees grow deep in Darkwood, near the bears.

stages.journal: Bring Gerd 8 ash logs and 5 elm logs.
remind: Eight ash logs and five elm logs. Ash trees at level 10, elm at 20.

stages.journal: Carve an elmwood shortbow at a workbench and bring it to Gerd.
remind: One more thing: the watch needs bows. Carve me an elmwood shortbow at my workbench. You'll need silk thread for the string.
done: A fine bow. The watch will be glad of it.

name: The Goblin Menace
summary: Captain Hale wants the goblin raids on the farms stopped for good.
offer: Goblins raid Hob's farm every other night. My guards can't be everywhere.
Thin their numbers at the camp to the north-west, then take the fight to their chieftain in the caves.
after: The farms sleep easy now. Come back if you want work.

stages.journal: Defeat 10 goblins at the goblin camp.
remind: Ten goblins. Their camp's north-west, past the farm.

stages.journal: Slay Goblin Chieftain Grukk in the Goblin Caves.
remind: Now the chieftain. Grukk lairs at the far end of the Goblin Caves.
done: Grukk's dead? Aldmoor owes you, friend.

name: A Feast for the King
summary: King Aldric is hosting the northern jarls and wants a feast worth remembering.
offer: The jarls of Skarn dine with me at the new moon. Diplomacy is won at the table.
My cooks are... uninspired. Would you prepare the courses?
after: My royal cook's feast pie recipe is yours. Few are trusted with it.

stages.journal: Bring King Aldric 2 venison stews, 3 salmon fillets and a berry pie.
remind: Two venison stews, three salmon fillets and a berry pie. Stews need meat, potato and onion.
done: Magnificent! The jarls will sing of this.

name: Rest for the Fallen King
summary: The Skeletal Warlord must be destroyed before he raises an army of the dead.
offer: The Fallen King was my great-grandfather. His bones will not rest.
Enter the Crypt beyond the river and end him. Aldmoor's finest smiths will reward you.
after: Brom has shared the old emberforge schematics with you. Forge weapons worthy of a hero.

stages.journal: Destroy the Skeletal Warlord in the Crypt of the Fallen King.
remind: The Skeletal Warlord waits in the deepest chamber of the Crypt, east past the graveyard.
done: It is done? Then he rests at last. Thank you.
